description: This file contains HTTP assertion helper functions for testing HTTP handlers, including status code checks, response body content checks, and request simulation.

methods.name: httpCode
methods.description: Helper function to get HTTP response code from a handler with given request parameters.

methods.name: HTTPSuccess
methods.description: Asserts that a handler returns a success status code (2xx or 3xx).

methods.name: HTTPRedirect
methods.description: Asserts that a handler returns a redirect status code (3xx).

methods.name: HTTPError
methods.description: Asserts that a handler returns an error status code (4xx or above).

methods.name: HTTPStatusCode
methods.description: Asserts that a handler returns a specific status code.

methods.name: HTTPBody
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response body as a string from a handler.

methods.name: HTTPBodyContains
methods.description: Checks if the response body contains a specific string.

methods.name: HTTPBodyNotContains
methods.description: Checks if the response body does not contain a specific string.
